instruction: Look at dual_pocket_bracket.step in NX CAM. Create roughing and finish passes for the two pockets in dual_pocket_bracket.step, then create a Planar Contour finish operation for the outside profile. Pocket floors must be Z=6.000 mm and the outside contour must machine down to Z=0.000 mm. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill for pocket roughing; T2 is a 6 mm end mill for finishing/profile contouring. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-7.nc.
